items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: in Earl Hines' band, there was some great trumpet players at the time; Freddie Webster, Ray Nance, [Ed] McConnell, the trumpet

ctx.x: Yeah, which is here now with us -- Cat Anderson was in the band. But I went to Bill Rivers, after the dance that night, because in Earl Hines' band, there was some great trumpet players at the time; Freddie Webster, Ray Nance, [Ed] McConnell, the trumpet -- and Pee Wee -- remember Pee Wee?
